t.68411-30-3.agn: It has no EU harmonised classification; in the registrants' joint notification it is classified as causing serious eye damage, skin irritation and harmful if swallowed. These classes apply to the pure substance; on the label it appears as a band such as 5–15%.
t.68411-30-3.reg.clp: No EU harmonised classification. Registrants' joint notification (51.7% of notifications): Acute Tox. 4 (Oral), Skin Irrit. 2, Eye Dam. 1, Aquatic Chronic 3.
t.68411-30-3.summary: One of the most common anionic surfactants.
t.68411-30-3.what: Lifts dirt and grease and keeps them suspended in water; produces foam.
